registers.label: Spare
lines: Consider the birds: they neither sow nor reap.
Yet your Father feeds them.
Look at the lilies, how they grow.
Not even Solomon was clothed like these.
So do not worry over your life.
Seek first the kingdom of God.
Come, let us worship with grateful hearts.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Consider the birds of the air; they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not worth more than they?
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
Look at the lilies of the field, how they grow without toiling; not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
The land has yielded its harvest, the rains have come, the threshing floors are full; do not be afraid, but be glad.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
So set down your worry, seek first the kingdom, and gather at the table of plenty. Come, let us worship.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Consider the birds; your Father feeds them.
We give you thanks.
See the lilies, clothed beyond Solomon.
We give you thanks.
Do not worry; seek first the kingdom.
We give you thanks.
Come to the table of plenty and worship.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. Amen.
